blocks.text: Assalam o alaikum bachon! Aaj hum Unit 12 shuru kar rahe hain: Limit and Continuity. Yeh unit aap ki maths ki zindagi ka ek mor (turning point) hai, kyun ke yahin se calculus ki bunyad rakhi jaati hai. Ghabraiye nahin, hum har lafz ko aahista aahista, misaalon ke saath samjhenge. Pehle dekhte hain ke kitab is unit ka taaruf (introduction) kaise karwati hai.

Kitab kehti hai ke maths mein limits aur continuity ke tasawwurat (concepts) functions aur sequences ka bartao (behaviour) samajhne ki bunyad hain, khaas taur par jab inhein haqeeqi duniya (real world) ke masail par lagaya jaye. Is chapter mein aap seekhenge ke kisi sequence aur kisi function ki limit kaise dikhai aur nikali jaati hai, continuous (bina toote, lagataar) aur discontinuous (toote hue) functions kya hote hain, aur in tasawwurat ko economics, finance aur natural sciences jaise shobon (fields) mein kaise istemal kiya jata hai.

Kitab aage kehti hai ke yeh unit aap ko woh auzaar (tools) dega jin se aap limits aur continuity ke bunyadi tasawwurat ko nazariyati (theoretical) aur amali (practical) dono tarah samajh aur istemal kar sakein. Unit ke aakhir tak aap kisi function ki limit dikha sakenge, continuity aur discontinuity ko test kar sakenge, aur in khayalat ko finance, economics aur science ke mukhtalif masail par laga sakenge.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Limit hai kya, ek jumle mein? Kisi point par function ki limit woh value hai jis ke qareeb function ke jawab (outputs) jaate chale jaate hain, jab input us point ke qareeb se qareeb tar hota jata hai.
Ek aasaan misaal sochiye. Aap ek deewar ki taraf chal rahe hain, aur har qadam baqi faasle ka aadha hai. Pehle 4 meter baqi the, phir 2, phir 1, phir aadha meter, phir chauthai... Aap deewar ke jitna chahein qareeb pohanch sakte hain, aur aap ki manzil deewar hi hai, chahe koi ek qadam bilkul deewar par khatam na ho. To deewar aap ki position ki limit hai.
Continuity doosra sawal poochti hai: kya function us point par sach mein wahi value leta hai, aur kya us ke graph mein koi khala (gap) ya chhalang (jump) to nahin? Yeh hum 12.3 mein parhenge.

blocks.text: Ab section 12.1 ki baat. Kitab kehti hai: function ki limit ka tasawwur woh bunyad hai jis par calculus ki poori imarat khari hai. Function ki limit ki definition se pehle zaroori hai ke neeche diye gaye jumlon (phrases) ka matlab achhi tarah samajh liya jaye.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Calculus (tabdeeli ki maths: raftaar, curve ka slope, curve ke neeche ka area) poori ki poori limits par khari hai. Misal ke taur par, kisi gaari ki ek khaas lamhe (instant) ki raftaar kaise nikalein? Distance ko time se divide karte hain, lekin ek lamhe mein time to zero hai, aur zero se divide nahin ho sakta. Hal yeh hai ke hum chhote se chhote waqfon (time intervals) ki average speed lete jaate hain, aur woh jis value ki taraf jaati hai, wahi us lamhe ki speed hai. Yeh hai limit ka kamaal.
Kitab jin jumlon ki baat kar rahi hai, woh agle teen sabaq hain:
12.1.1 "\(x\) approaches zero" (\(x \to 0\)), yani \(x\) zero ke qareeb jata hai
12.1.2 "\(x\) approaches infinity" (\(x \to \infty\)), yani \(x\) behad bara hota jata hai
12.1.3 "\(x\) approaches \(a\)" (\(x \to a\)), yani \(x\) kisi number \(a\) ke qareeb jata hai
Teer ka nishan \(\to\) "approaches" (qareeb jata hai) ya "tends to" parha jata hai. Yeh values ki harkat (movement) batata hai, kisi ek value ko nahin.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Aap ek glass mein paani daal rahe hain aur har baar baqi khaali hisse ka aadha bharte hain. Glass kitna bhara hua "approach" kar raha hai?
Jawab: poora glass (100%). Pehle 50%, phir 75%, phir 87.5%, phir 93.75%... Har baar poore glass ke aur qareeb, lekin kisi ek baar mein bilkul 100% nahin. To 100% is amal ki limit hai. Yahi soch aage har sabaq mein kaam aayegi.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Number \(\frac{1}{3} = 0.3333\ldots\) ko dekhiye. Uske decimal hisse ek ek kar ke likhte jaayein: \(0.3\), \(0.33\), \(0.333\), \(0.3333\), ...
Har naya number \(\frac{1}{3}\) ke aur qareeb hai. Farq pehle \(\frac{1}{30}\), phir \(\frac{1}{300}\), phir \(\frac{1}{3000}\) hai, yani har dafa das guna kam. Kisi bhi khatam hone wale (finite) decimal ke saath farq zero nahin hota, lekin jitna chahein chhota ho sakta hai. Is liye kehte hain ke yeh numbers \(\frac{1}{3}\) ko approach karte hain, aur \(\frac{1}{3}\) in ki limit hai.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Kisi point par function ki limit woh value hai jis ke qareeb outputs jaate hain jab input us point ke qareeb jata hai.
2. Limits calculus ki bunyad hain; raftaar, slope aur area sab limits se nikalte hain.
3. Nishan \(\to\) ka matlab "qareeb jata hai" hai; yeh barabar (\(=\)) ka nishan nahin.
4. Unit 12 ka safar: limit ka tasawwur (12.1), limits nikalna (12.2), continuity (12.3), applications (12.4).

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. \(x \to 0\) ko "\(x = 0\)" parhna. Teer ka matlab hai \(x\) zero ke qareeb se qareeb tar ho raha hai, zero hai nahin. 12.1.3 ka "Point to remember" box isi baat ke liye hai.
2. Yeh samajhna ke limit hamesha point par function ki value hi hoti hai. Aksar hoti hai, lekin 12.2 mein aap aise bohat se functions dekhenge jin ki limit ek point par maujood hai jab ke us point par function ki koi value hi nahin. Is liye limit ko "qareeb jaane" ke maane mein samjhiye, "rakh dene" ke maane mein nahin.
